# Ethers v0.6.12 - Table of Contents

A comprehensive Web3 library for interacting with smart contracts on Ethereum using Elixir.

## Pages

- [Introduction](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Typed Arguments](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/typed-arguments.md)
- [Configuration](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/configuration.md)
- [Upgrading](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/upgrading.md)

## Modules

- [Ethers](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.md): high-level module providing a convenient and efficient interface for interacting
with the Ethereum blockchain using Elixir.
- [Ethers.CcipRead](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.CcipRead.md): CCIP Read ([EIP-3668](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3668)) implementation
- [Ethers.Contract](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contract.md): Dynamically creates modules for ABIs at compile time.
- [Ethers.Event](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Event.md): EVM Event struct and helpers

- [Ethers.EventFilter](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.EventFilter.md): Event Filter struct and helper functions to work with the event filters

- [Ethers.Multicall](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Multicall.md): This module offers convenient utilities and a user-friendly API for interacting with
`Multicall3` (for more information, visit https://www.multicall3.com).
- [Ethers.NameService](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.NameService.md): Name Service resolution implementation for ENS (Ethereum Name Service).
Supports both forward and reverse resolution plus reverse lookups.
- [Ethers.TxData](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.TxData.md): Transaction struct to hold information about the ABI selector, encoded data
and the target `to` address.

- [Ethers.Types](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Types.md): EVM types and compound type definitions
- [Ethers.Utils](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Utils.md): Utilities for interacting with ethereum blockchain

- Transactions
  - [Ethers.Transaction](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Transaction.md): Transaction struct and helper functions for handling EVM transactions.
  - [Ethers.Transaction.Eip1559](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Transaction.Eip1559.md): Transaction struct and protocol implementation for Ethereum Improvement Proposal (EIP) 1559
transactions. EIP-1559 introduced a new fee market mechanism with base fee and priority fee.
  - [Ethers.Transaction.Eip2930](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Transaction.Eip2930.md): Transaction struct and protocol implementation for Ethereum Improvement Proposal (EIP) 2930
transactions. EIP-2930 introduced a new transaction type that includes an access list,
allowing transactions to pre-specify and pre-pay for account and storage access to mitigate
gas cost changes from EIP-2929 and prevent contract breakage. The access list format also
enables future use cases like block-wide witnesses and static state access patterns.
  - [Ethers.Transaction.Eip4844](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Transaction.Eip4844.md): Transaction struct and protocol implementation for Ethereum Improvement Proposal (EIP) 4844
transactions. EIP-4844 introduced "blob-carrying transactions" which contain a large amount
of data that cannot be accessed by EVM execution, but whose commitment can be accessed.
  - [Ethers.Transaction.Legacy](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Transaction.Legacy.md): Legacy transaction struct and implementation of Transaction.Protocol.

  - [Ethers.Transaction.Metadata](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Transaction.Metadata.md): Metadata for a transaction like block hash, block number, and transaction index.

  - [Ethers.Transaction.Protocol](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Transaction.Protocol.md): Protocol for handling Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) transactions.

  - [Ethers.Transaction.Signed](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Transaction.Signed.md): A struct that wraps a transaction and its signature values.

- Builtin Contracts
  - [Ethers.Contracts.CcipRead](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.CcipRead.md): CCIP Read ([EIP-3668](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3668)) contract

  - [Ethers.Contracts.ENS](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ENS.md): Ethereum Name Service (ENS) Contract

  - [Ethers.Contracts.ENS.ExtendedResolver](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ENS.ExtendedResolver.md): Extended ENS resolver as per [ENSIP-10](https://docs.ens.domains/ensip/10)

  - [Ethers.Contracts.ENS.Resolver](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ENS.Resolver.md): Ethereum Name Service (ENS) Resolver Contract

  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC1155](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC1155.md): ERC1155 token interface
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC165](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC165.md): ERC-165 Standard Interface Detection
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC20](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC20.md): ERC20 token interface
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC721](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC721.md): ERC721 token interface
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC777](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC777.md): ERC777 token interface
  - [Ethers.Contracts.Multicall3](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.Multicall3.md): Multicall3 token interface

- Builtin EventFilters
  - [Ethers.Contracts.CcipRead.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.CcipRead.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.CcipRead`
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ENS.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ENS.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.ENS`
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ENS.ExtendedResolver.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ENS.ExtendedResolver.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.ENS.ExtendedResolver`
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ENS.Resolver.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ENS.Resolver.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.ENS.Resolver`
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC1155.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC1155.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.ERC1155`
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC165.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC165.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.ERC165`
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC20.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC20.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.ERC20`
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC721.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC721.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.ERC721`
  - [Ethers.Contracts.ERC777.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.ERC777.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.ERC777`
  - [Ethers.Contracts.Multicall3.EventFilters](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Contracts.Multicall3.EventFilters.md): Events for `Ethers.Contracts.Multicall3`

- Signer
  - [Ethers.Signer](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Signer.md): Signer behaviour.
  - [Ethers.Signer.JsonRPC](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Signer.JsonRPC.md): Signer capable of signing transactions with a JSON RPC server
capable of `eth_signTransaction` and `eth_accounts` RPC functions.
  - [Ethers.Signer.Local](https://ethers.hexdocs.pm/Ethers.Signer.Local.md): Local signer works with a private key.

- Builtin Contract Errors
